A top-down RPG character walk-cycle sprite sheet, RPG-Maker-charset convention, laid out as a precise grid. THE GRID LINES ARE THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS IMAGE AND MUST BE DRAWN: THIN SOLID BRIGHT MAGENTA (#FF00FF) DIVIDER LINES, 3px wide, running the FULL width and the FULL height of the image, separating every row from the next and every column from the next, and also framing the outside of the grid. They must be pure saturated magenta, unmistakable against the green, never dark, never grey, never faint, never omitted — the sheet is cut up mechanically along these lines and is worthless without them. Every cell's background must be flat, solid, pure CHROMA-KEY GREEN (#00FF00), completely uniform, with a crisp hard edge against the character and no blended halo. Grid: 4 rows x 3 columns, every cell exactly the same size. CRITICAL, in every cell without exception: the character is a FULL BODY figure, head down to feet, feet clearly visible, filling nearly the full cell height — NEVER a bust, NEVER cropped at the waist or hip. Character centred, identical scale in every cell. THE WHOLE CHARACTER MUST FIT INSIDE ITS OWN CELL WITH CLEAR GREEN SPACE ON BOTH SIDES: nothing they have — a tail, a swinging coat, spread hair, an outstretched arm — may touch or cross a magenta divider or run off the edge of the image. Every cell is cut out along those lines, so anything reaching one is sliced off in the finished sprite. If a pose needs more room, draw the character slightly smaller in EVERY cell rather than letting one of them touch a line. RPG-Maker 3-frame walk cycle per row: Column 2 (the MIDDLE one) = a true NEUTRAL STANDING pose, legs straight and together, arms relaxed — exactly what the character looks like standing still. Column 1 = mid-step, LEFT foot planted forward and right foot back with a clear gap between them, opposite arm swung. Column 3 = mid-step, RIGHT foot planted forward and left foot back — the opposite stride to column 1, and clearly NOT a repeat of the standing pose in column 2. Row 1 (top) = facing DOWN toward the viewer. Row 2 = facing LEFT in TRUE SIDE PROFILE — seen from the side, nose pointing left, one shoulder toward the viewer, NOT a front-facing pose turned slightly, and the legs must clearly stride past each other in columns 1 and 3. Row 3 = facing RIGHT in true side profile, the exact mirror of row 2. Row 4 (bottom) = facing UP, back view — even from behind it is a full standing body: head with hair, shoulders, torso, legs, visible feet, NOT a shapeless blob of hair. The character: {CHARACTER}. Use any reference image ONLY for design and colour likeness, never for pose or crop. Nothing else in the image: no text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no scenery.
